stem.text: The photomicrograph shows cells in different stages of mitosis.

stem.alt: Light micrograph of cells with labels P, Q, R, S and T pointing to individual cells.

items: DNA replication occurs in cell R.
The amount of DNA in cell P is the same as in cell T.
The correct order for the stages is $\text{S} \rightarrow \text{R} \rightarrow \text{T} \rightarrow \text{P} \rightarrow \text{Q}$.
